todos.description: Consolidate candidate_materials.md: merge root and docs versions into a single authoritative file, add a prominent disclaimer that predicted Tc values are theoretical, and populate the empty 'Multi-Criteria Decision Matrix' section with criteria (Tc, pressure, stability, feasibility) and scores for top candidates.

Implement a working DFT interface in dft_calculator.py (e.g., wrappers for Quantum ESPRESSO or VASP) to compute electron-phonon coupling and Tc for candidate hydrides, or integrate with an existing DFT engine.

Populate data/superconductor_database.json with real entries from literature or public databases (e.g., SuperCon) including verified Tc, composition, structure, and pressure for at least 100 compounds, removing any placeholder/mock data.
Complete streamlit_dashboard.py to display candidate materials, predicted Tc, experimental results, and allow filtering, connecting it to the pipeline outputs and the superconductor database.

Implement missing functions (fetch_materials_project, fetch_icsd, fetch_arxiv) in scripts/api_client.py and update tests/test_api_client.py to use the correct mocking targets (e.g., PipelineClient.session.get) so that all tests pass.

Add detailed step-by-step manufacturing pathways to proposed_chemistry_physics.md for top hydride candidates (YH10, CaH12, MgH16) including target pressure, laser heating temperature, dwell time, quenching rate, and in-situ characterization steps, with references to Drozdov et al. (Nature 2019) and Kong et al. (Nat. Commun. 2021).

Update discovery_strategy.md to include a prioritization section that ranks candidate materials by a combined metric of predicted Tc and synthesis pressure, highlighting materials like CaH12 (Tc ~305 K at 200 GPa) and Li2MgH16 (Tc ~240 K at 200 GPa) with a scoring table.

Update experimental_feedback_loop.md to incorporate latest research findings (e.g., La3Ni2O7 at 80 K, retracted claims) and add concrete experimental plans for top candidates (YH10, CaH12) with specific synthesis parameters, in-situ XRD, and resistivity measurement steps.
